The Tremendous Z-Move!'') is the 13th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Sun}} successfully activates {{m|Inferno Overdrive}} and has {{adv|Dollar}} use it on [[Gladion]]'s {{TP|Gladion|Type: Null}}. * {{p|Type: Null}}'s mask begins to break, forcing Gladion to return it out of fear of what will happen. * Deciding that {{p|Tapu Lele}} is too weak, Gladion retreats and tells everyone that [[Ultra Wormhole]]s exits and that something is trying to break free from them. * After Tapu Lele awakens, Sun successfully delivers the [[Mirage Berry]] to it, completing his task. * Tapu Lele challenges the group to a battle to test their resolve. * Despite Tapu Lele's strength, {{adv|Dollar}} manages to land a hit on it after [[Evolution|evolving]] into a {{p|Torracat}}. * Worried about what Gladion said, {{adv|Moon}} consults the {{adv|Rotom Pokédex}} as [[Ultra Beast]]s could be trying to appear in Alola.
